review_scope: Consumed existing complete small proofs and already-scored scalars; checked proof/consumer bindings, five-domain macro and contrast arithmetic, all five recorded input metadata sequences, completion/reload/count/budget summaries. Did not rerun a verifier, consumer, score, bootstrap, QA/model, or large checkpoint hash.
accepted_interpretation: Both conditions genuinely reduce complete weight coefficients and FP16 weight bytes. Complete package sizes additionally include ordinary buffers, state/config metadata and container overhead; they are distinct from tensor bytes and process RAM.

The fixed KeepGate priority hypothesis failed: its final macro is below KeepUp and both are far below the predeclared wide-q/v point. Close both fixed role/rank200 conditions without search, recovery, retry or full confirmation.

Both compressed initial answering scores are already near zero versus the same-input fresh parent. Preserving the complete original gate and down is insufficient to preserve parent answering when up alone is independently compressed to rank200 across all 24 layers under this construction.

The input consumer binds all five recorded prediction files to their existing COMPLETE and VERIFIED proofs. Their per-ID prepared tensors have identical recorded digests, so the observed role/initial differences cannot be explained by different recorded generation inputs here.

Continuous q/v training occurred for the complete planned 19/87 schedule in both arms. Positive initial-to-final score changes are observed, but neither final macro recovers the unadapted parent level. Final trainable=0 describes the folded/frozen endpoint, not absence of training.

KeepUp has the higher final point estimate in this failed-quality regime. This does not establish a broadly preferable projection role or pure learning advantage: starting functions differ and the adaptation difference does not isolate representational sufficiency from optimization.

RUN and exit upper bounds overlap and must not be added. Process RSS/HWM and sampled allocator/NVML maxima are full-execution observations, not controlled inference peaks or a controlled speed comparison. CPU gate/transport/review/waiting/verification remain separately recorded.

design_consequence.ruled_out_for_selection: The specific assumption that preserving dense gate/down while compressing only up to rank200 supplies a usable answering carrier and warrants priority over the matched keep-up allocation with the original q/v budget.
design_consequence.new_information_relative_to_old_three_pr: The severe initial answering loss is not confined to simultaneous gate/up/down rank truncation. It also occurs in this single-up replacement while original gate and down weights are retained. Whole-model reduction of 8.61 percent does not imply a mild intervention on the selected projection family.
not_ruled_out: Gate usefulness or up usefulness in general
Other low-rank representations, scopes, ranks, initializations or recovery regimes
The existence of a compact carrier with adequate functional plasticity
Any universal LoRA, cold-start or OSFT/PAS mechanism claim
design_consequence.functional_evidence_still_missing: A genuinely smaller complete carrier that actually preserves a usable portion of parent answering on bound inputs, followed by evidence that its continuous adaptation preserves or improves that capability. This result supplies neither such a carrier nor an isolated reason for the strong references learning better.
design_consequence.next_action: Publish this completed fixed-point negative and close it. No automatic new compression tool, changed rank/LR, added recovery, or new model is authorized.

limitations: Explored 100 DEV, 20 QA per domain, one seed; no bootstrap/significance/stability/equivalence claim.

Prepared-input equality covers the recorded generation-before tensors, not proof of all internal activations, full execution paths, training-input equality, unknown near-duplicate absence or pretraining overlap.
Retained gate weights do not keep actual gate responses invariant when upstream hidden inputs change.
Do not infer that gate or up is universally unnecessary, that all low-rank methods fail, that no task learning happened, or that the failure identifies specific knowledge content.
No cold-start causal question was tested; the q/v trajectory is continuous and its ordinary per-stage optimizer reset is shared.
The result is an informative structural negative with measured weight reduction and lost quality, not a compact high-quality framework or permission to reopen a closed branch.

report_and_terminal_review.report_scope: The Chinese report correctly separates initial answering loss from final improvement, actual weight reduction from failed quality, frozen endpoint flags from training history, and sampled full-run memory from controlled inference measurements.
